description: This file defines the ServiceContainer class within the OrangeHRM framework, responsible for implementing a singleton pattern to manage and provide access to a ContainerBuilder instance for dependency injection purposes.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Framework\ServiceContainer
classes.description: A singleton class that encapsulates a ContainerBuilder instance for dependency injection, ensuring only one instance exists throughout the application.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the ServiceContainer, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Provides access to the ContainerBuilder instance managed by the ServiceContainer singleton.
